reason: Uji Sangar no pada native dan 200px: tokoh terlalu terbaca sebagai pekerja biasa mengecat ter meskipun latar Bulan; adegan belum menunjukkan pencurian cahaya yang menggetarkan.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Rahko in his specifically documented Mano-Rakko Moon-thief variant: the thief trapped on the Moon while covering its light with tar [rahko-c05].
ANATOMY: one human-shaped thief, one head, two arms, two legs, fully opaque rough dark work robe and boots; one hand grips a heavy open bucket full of thick black tar, the other a wide bristle brush [rahko-c05].
MOMENT: wrenching his whole body across the foreground toward the viewer as he sweeps a broad load of tar over the luminous lunar surface below; face strained and determined, robe caught in his movement, bucket tilted so long viscous drips stretch down.
POWER: a wet jet-black tar swath physically smothers the pale reflected moonlight beneath his brush, a dramatic boundary of illuminated pale lunar rock and completely black tar, his documented act of stealing the Moon's light [rahko-c05]. NO magical glow around the figure.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low close angle from the lunar rock at his boots, figure, bucket and brush dominate most of square; no giant proportions, no tiny distant man. A curved lunar horizon only at the upper edge.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one low hard reflected lunar light across wet tar, antique silver highlights and deep walnut-black shadows; no atmosphere or clouds on the Moon.
SURFACE: rough craters, black viscous tar, brush bristles clotted with tar, worn opaque cloth and bucket iron.
SETTING: on the Moon itself against a deep black sky [rahko-c05].
MOOD: ominous, awe-inspiring impossible lunar action, active and overwhelming, never an ordinary worker portrait.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no other figures, no extra limbs or fingers, no text, lettering, logos, border or watermark; no stars as runes; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons; no gore, nudity or borrowed entertainment design.

visual_requirements.description: Satu sosok pencuri manusia dengan dua tangan memegang ember ter dan kuas.
Ter hitam pekat menutupi permukaan Bulan secara fisik dan mengurangi cahaya di belakangnya.
